The '''''Urrob''''' was a [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] that served with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was used to deliver replacement [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']] near [[Essebra]], in the [[Essebra system/Legends|Essebra system]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />
